title: West Bank Economy Risks Economic Catastrophe If Israeli Lenders Cut Ties
title_cn: 如果以色列银行断绝关系，西岸经济将面临经济灾难的风险
summary: Palestinian and Israeli officials are warning of an economic crisis if Israeli lenders cut off financial ties to their West Bank counterparts in the fall.
